tests.name: Infinite streaming is deterministic across positive and negative coordinates and bounded after long travel
The old map edge can be crossed, and invalid coordinates still collide
Defeats, partial damage, chests and environmental state survive chunk eviction and revisit
Save/restore preserves distant negative position and changed chunks without serializing generated chunks
A v0.4 save retains original hero, HP, gold and original quest and receives infinite terrain
Elemental targeting and saved clones retain their distant coordinates instead of clamping to the old map
New F interactions activate Chu Dong Tu and Jack relic hooks when the full skill module is loaded
Core environmental objects can be used once and persist; elemental barrel explosion cannot recur
All six chapters enforce three echoes, start distinct bosses, award once and allow postgame exploration
Saga fight save preserves boss and anchors, discards pending attacks and death resets the encounter
Post-Coi-Da endless enemies and ring/line boss attacks still deal real damage
